blogs.title: The Intrinsic Evidence Exception: Admitting Prior Possession in Gun Cases
blogs.description: This post analyzes the Eighth Circuit's reliance on the 'intrinsic evidence' exception to Rule 404(b) in United States v. Cutbank. It examines the court's reasoning that prior possession of the specific firearm at issue is directly relevant to proving continuous ownership and control, rather than impermissible propensity evidence. The discussion explores how this precedent aligns with United States v. Battle and its implications for defense strategies in felon-in-possession trials.

blogs.title: ACCA and Guidelines: Navigating the 'Connection with Another Felony' Enhancement
blogs.description: This entry focuses on the sentencing calculation where the Armed Career Criminal Act triggered mandatory minimums, yet the USSG § 2K2.1(b)(6)(B) enhancement for possession in connection with another felony dictated the offense level. It discusses the 'greater offense level applies' rule, the interplay between ACCA findings and Guidelines enhancements, and the appellate standard for reviewing the substantive reasonableness of within-range sentences under 18 U.S.C. § 3553(a).

blogs.title: Confrontation Clause Compliance: The Cure of Live Testimony in Domestic Violence Cases
blogs.description: This post explores the intersection of the Confrontation Clause and hearsay in domestic violence and firearm prosecutions. It analyzes how the Eighth Circuit determined that the victim's live testimony cured potential hearsay issues regarding her statements to police, satisfying Crawford requirements. Additionally, it considers the court's Rule 403 analysis regarding the admission of prejudicial background testimony about the victim's family history during cross-examination.
